claims.evidence: Witness photo shows only a close-up of tread/sidewall with no readable brand/model markings and no visible tyre size (width/aspect/rim).
Witness notes worn tread with uneven/patchy scuffing and dirt; no tread-depth measurement or full circumference shown to support a 90% estimate.
No patch/repair area is shown clearly in the single close-up; the report does not include a full view of both sidewalls and the entire tread surface.
A bulge would typically be visible from side angles and across the full circumference; only one close-up is reported.
No manufacturing date code (DOT) or proof of vehicle year is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Tyre size/fitment mismatch (wrong 295/40R20 or wrong rim compatibility) leading to unusable purchase
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full sidewall showing the exact size marking (e.g., 295/40R20) and any load/speed rating.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-size used car tyre (worst-case fitment risk) until the exact sidewall markings are readable.

risks.risk: Brand/model not actually Tukubo (could be a different brand/grade/compound)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the sidewall brand/name and model text (not just tread close-up).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unknown brand used tyre until brand is confirmed from readable sidewall text.

risks.risk: Overstated tread life (90% claim may be inaccurate; uneven wear suggests less remaining life)
risks.proof: A tread-depth measurement in mm at multiple points (center and shoulders) plus a full tread circumference photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a worn used tyre with uneven wear (worst-case remaining life) until tread depth is measured.

risks.risk: Hidden damage: sidewall cuts, cracks, or internal damage not visible in the single close-up
risks.proof: Photos of both sidewalls from bead to shoulder, plus a close-up of any suspect areas (cracks/cuts) and the bead area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/unsafe used tyre (worst-case) until sidewall and bead condition are clearly shown.

risks.risk: Repair/patch/plug not visible in the reported angle (could leak under load)
risks.proof: A full tread surface photo (both sides) and close-ups of any repair-looking spots; ideally a photo showing the inside area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed leak-free (worst-case) until repair status is confirmed visually.

risks.risk: Age/production date unknown (DOT not shown); tyre may be older than claimed 2023
risks.proof: A clear photo of the DOT/manufacturing date code on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: Price as older used tyre until DOT date is confirmed.

risks.risk: Air-holding/condition unknown (no confirmation it holds air; bead seating/true condition not shown)
risks.proof: A short clip showing the tyre inflated and holding air (e.g., gauge reading) and a photo of the bead seating/fitment surface.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'as-is, not confirmed holding air' (worst-case) until inflation/air-holding is demonstrated.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the entire sidewall showing the exact size marking (295/40R20) and load/speed rating.
Send a clear photo showing the brand/model text (Tukubo) on the sidewall.
Provide tread-depth measurements (mm) at center and both shoulders, plus a full tread circumference photo.
Send photos of both sidewalls (bead to shoulder) showing no cracks/cuts/bulges.
Send full tread photos from multiple angles to confirm no patch/plug and no uneven damage.
Provide a short clip/photo showing the tyre inflated with a pressure gauge reading (to confirm it holds air).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a car tyre but the key details needed to price it safely (exact size/brand, tread depth, DOT date, and full damage/repair status) are not readable or not shown. Without those, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
